text:
Maya: Heads up — prototype for a fallback panel that surfaces rate-policy hits & lets operators hand off decisions. WIP figma mock in the link. Need input on behavior for fail modes and quota semantics.
Alex: link? :eyes:
Maya: https://figma.com/proto/fallback-panel (mock). Main idea: when a route crosses an error threshold an automatic fallback kicks in. Console shows a toast with reason and buttons: [snooze] [reduce-to-x%] [full-redirect].
Sam: Concern — if operators snooze without reducing traffic we risk burning committed quota quickly. Need a per-route quota throttle option or a simulated degrade mode first.
Leia: Agree. Suggest a "reduce-until-window" option that lowers routing weight instead of immediate full redirect. Also show estimated quota burn impact in the UI.
Tomas: Telemetry ask: emit a machine-readable audit event "fallback_decision" with fields: route, trigger, mode, pre_qps, post_qps, operator_action, decision_id. Also capture a 1% sample of full traces for postmortem.
deploy-bot: deploybot: canary deploy finished on staging (sha=abc123) — no fallback triggers in 30m smoke.
Alex: On naming: avoid ambiguous terms like "soft"/"hard". Propose names: "reduced-throughput" and "full-redirect".
Maya: Naming ACK. UX question: operator inbox shows pending fallbacks — should an ack mark item as "monitored" or "resolved"? "Monitored" keeps sampling so we can compare upstream vs fallback outputs.
Sam: Keep "monitored" as default. Also add an auto-unroll after X minutes if error rate drops below threshold. That reduces stale overrides.
Leia: Audit retention: fallback events should be retained 90 days and be exportable to BigQuery. Keep small redacted prompt/response snippets for regression but PII must be stripped.
Tomas: Implementation note: propose proto schema v1: ``FallbackEvent { string route = 1; string trigger = 2; string mode = 3; string decision_id = 4; map<string,string> tags = 5; }``. Decision_id ties UI action to request-level logs.
Maya: One more: operator override must mint a decision_token attached to subsequent requests for traceability + cost attribution.
Alex: :thumbsup: I'll iterate on the interaction flow and update the prototype. Can folks +1 if they prefer "reduced-throughput" / "full-redirect" naming and the operator inbox semantics?
Sam: +1
Leia: +1 for retention + redaction rules
Tomas: :eyes: I'll open a telemetry PR with schema and add a sample BigQuery export SQL.
Maya: Thanks — I'll add the quota-impact estimate to the mock and push an updated figma.
